description.zh:
自定义域名。不传该字段表示不更新自定义域名，设置为空字符串表示删除自定义域名。

在绑定自定义域名前，要求您的域名已经接入阿里云备案，并且已配置解析CNAME到CustomDomainCname。
description.en:
Custom domain name. If you do not pass this field, the custom domain name is not updated. If you set it to an empty string, the custom domain name is deleted.

Before binding a custom domain name, your domain name must have an Alibaba Cloud ICP filing and a CNAME record configured to CustomDomainCname.

description.zh: 自定义域名的HTTPS证书。必须和CustomDomainPrivateKey一起使用，不传这两个字段表示不更新证书，都传空字符串表示删除证书。
description.en: The HTTPS certificate for the custom domain name. Use this with CustomDomainPrivateKey. If you do not pass these two fields, the certificate is not updated. If you pass empty strings for both, the certificate is deleted.

description.zh: 自定义域名的HTTPS证书的私钥。必须和CustomDomainCertificate一起使用，不传这两个字段表示不更新证书，都传空字符串表示删除证书。
description.en: The private key for the custom domain name's HTTPS certificate. Use this with CustomDomainCertificate. If you do not pass these two fields, the certificate is not updated. If you pass empty strings for both, the certificate is deleted.

description.zh:
设置是否开启HTTP触发功能。取值：

- **true**：表示开启HTTP触发功能。
- **false**：表示关闭HTTP触发功能。
description.en:
Sets whether to enable the HTTP trigger feature. Values:

- **true**: Enables the HTTP trigger feature.

- **false**: Disables the HTTP trigger feature.

title.zh: 更新云函数的HTTP触发配置
title.en: Update the HTTP trigger configuration of a cloud function

descriptions.zh: 开启HTTP触发功能，系统会为开启HTTP触发功能的Space分配一个默认域名，然后再结合UpdateFunction接口给云函数设置一个触发路径，之后就可以通过HTTP请求来触发云函数调用。您可以绑定自己的域名来使用HTTP触发的功能，要求您的域名必须接入阿里云备案。您还可以给您的自定义域名绑定HTTPS证书，之后可以使用HTTPS协议加自定义域名来访问。
descriptions.en: Enable the HTTP trigger feature. The system assigns a default domain name to Spaces that have the HTTP trigger feature enabled. Then, you can set a trigger path for the cloud function using the UpdateFunction API. Afterward, you can trigger function invocation with HTTP requests. To use the HTTP trigger feature with your own domain name, bind a custom domain name. Your custom domain name must have an Alibaba Cloud ICP filing. Also bind an HTTPS certificate to your custom domain name. You can then access the function using the HTTPS protocol and your custom domain name.
